svg.title: 狗尾草墨线图 · 原生矢量重建
svg.desc: Setaria viridis. Native path reconstruction of the generated three-culm illustration; morphology-informed illustration, not a measured specimen. Leaves include parallel veins and connected sheaths. Compact panicles contain short branchlets, spikelets and bristles. No embedded raster. White organ fills preserve overlap; page background is transparent.
